projects.title: Wearable Smartwatch
projects.summary: A wrist-worn health and notification device built around a low-power microcontroller, featuring heart-rate sensing, step counting, and a custom energy-efficient display driver.
highlights: Custom PCB with integrated power management for multi-day battery life
Real-time heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography signals
Bluetooth Low Energy sync with a companion mobile interface

projects.title: Environmental Monitoring Station
projects.summary: A solar-powered station that logs air quality, temperature, humidity, and particulate matter, transmitting readings to a cloud dashboard for long-term environmental study.
highlights: Autonomous solar operation with battery backup for continuous logging
Calibrated particulate-matter and gas sensors for research-grade data
Remote data transmission with a live web dashboard

projects.title: Low-Cost Data Logger
projects.summary: A compact, reconfigurable data acquisition unit designed for undergraduate physics laboratories, making precise measurement accessible on a modest departmental budget.
highlights: Modular sensor inputs for temperature, light, voltage, and current
On-board SD storage with timestamped CSV export
Built and documented for classroom reproduction by students
